description: Source code for rendering 3D cylinders with faces and edges, including caps, using OpenGL functions and Lua bindings.

methods.name: lu5_render_cylinder_faces
methods.description: Renders the faces of a cylinder with optional top and bottom caps, using specified detail levels and color.

methods.name: lu5_render_cylinder_edges
methods.description: Renders the edges of a cylinder, including vertical, horizontal, diagonal lines, and optional caps, with specified detail levels and color.
